title: epan/proto.h: document freeing of GPtrArrays
description:
`epan/proto.c` has comments stating that the `GPtrArray` return values of
`proto_find_[first_]finfo()` must be freed, and that the return value of
`proto_get_finfo_ptr_array()` must *not* be freed. Copy those comments to
`epan/proto.h` for people who set their API expectations from reading
the header files.

Add comments to both files for `proto_all_finfos()` to say that its
return value must also be freed.

[skip ci]

changes_data.diff:
@@ -11303,7 +11303,10 @@ every_finfo(proto_node *node, void * data)
 	return false;
 }
 
-/* Return GPtrArray* of field_info pointers containing all hfindexes that appear in a tree. */
+/* Return GPtrArray* of field_info pointers containing all hfindexes that appear in a tree.
+ * The caller does need to free the returned GPtrArray with
+ * g_ptr_array_free(<array>, true).
+ */
 GPtrArray *
 proto_all_finfos(proto_tree *tree)
 {
